source_observations.text: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
